name: homeassistant
title: Home Assistant
description: Local home automation. Runs with host networking for device discovery; nothing else depends on it.
external: Update checks, integrations and cloud features you configure in Home Assistant itself; opt-in analytics is off unless you enable it during onboarding
notes: Open http://ha.<domain>:8123 to onboard. Home Assistant listens on port 8123 on all host interfaces (host networking).
